sections.title: Recover the reservoir before drying the masonry
paragraphs: At approved accessible points, reachable standing water is collected and its movement observed. Collection is repeated where separate affected cells require access, without washing water into an adjoining wall or floor cavity. Persistent refill sends the work back to the source and connected-cell investigation.

Once accessible free water is removed, drying addresses moisture absorbed in block and mortar. Obstructive finish layers receive their own removal decision. Material-appropriate observations track the exposed masonry; a dry room face alone cannot resolve an inaccessible cell reservoir.

sections.title: Repair access openings after the wall is ready

New paint or wall lining follows the requirements of the retained masonry and selected finish. A cell that could not be inspected or drained remains unresolved rather than disappearing from the scope when the face is repainted.

If access requires disconnecting, lifting or moving a panel, that task remains with the solar provider. Soot inside electrical enclosures or beneath a sealed module is outside surface cleaning and requires qualified equipment review.

sections.title: Keep cleaning records separate from system recommissioning
